# Clausent

> AI-powered contract intelligence platform for small and medium businesses.

Clausent helps businesses analyze, monitor, and renegotiate their contracts using artificial intelligence. Upload any contract (PDF or DOCX) and receive instant risk analysis, renewal alerts, market benchmarks, and renegotiation playbooks.

## Key Features

- **Smart Upload**: Extract key terms, dates, and pricing from PDF/DOCX contracts
- **Risk Scoring**: AI-generated 0-100 risk score for every contract
- **Auto-Alerts**: Automated renewal and deadline notifications
- **Market Benchmarks**: Compare your contract terms with market data
- **Renegotiation Kit**: AI-generated playbooks to help save money
- **Dashboard**: Complete contract portfolio overview

## Pricing

- **Starter** ($29/mo): Up to 10 contracts, basic risk analysis
- **Professional** ($59/mo): Up to 50 contracts, full analysis + benchmarks
- **Business** ($99/mo): Up to 200 contracts, renegotiation kit + API
- **Enterprise** (Custom): Unlimited contracts, SSO, dedicated support

Annual billing saves 20%.
